_comment: Synthetic internal postings in the SmartRecruiters Posting API shape (GET /v1/companies/{company}/postings, with jobAd inlined). Used only while SMARTRECRUITERS_COMPANY_ID is not set. releasedDaysAgo and hiringManagerId are demo-only fields.

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
Join the Data Science department to turn finance-operations data into insight.

  • Build and maintain SQL data sets from the ERP and the AP / O2C sub-ledgers
  • Automate recurring analysis in Python
  • Design Power BI dashboards for process owners
  • Explain trends and anomalies to finance leaders

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
• SQL and data wrangling
  • Python for analysis
  • Power BI or similar visualisation
  • Basic statistics
  • Clear data storytelling

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
Build the models that predict late payments, duplicate invoices and cash-flow risk.

  • Develop and validate machine-learning models in Python
  • Design experiments and measure impact
  • Partner with AP, O2C and Treasury on adoption

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text: Lead a procure-to-pay team: invoice processing, three-way match exceptions and payment runs, with quality and SLA ownership.

jobDescription.title: Job Description
